Team —

Quick handoff for SolsticeCare (deal RDW-4821). We closed last week and legal returned the signed T&Cs (attached). High level context and asks below so CS can pick up the implementation:

External contacts:
- Samantha Lee, Head of Product (primary) — samantha@solsticecare.com
- Rajiv Patel, VP Ops (backup; will own procurement) — rajiv@solsticecare.com

Contract / timing:
- Contract value: $420k ARR (first-year committed)
- Start date: 2026-08-15 (license activation)
- Target pilot go-live: 2026-10-01 (30-day pilot with 1k monthly queries)
- Production go-live target: 2027-01-04 (phased roll-out)

Technical notes / constraints:
- They will deploy via Redwood Dedicated in us-west-2. Customer requests private peering to avoid public egress for token-level logs.
- Expected peak QPS during pilot: 10 TPS with bursts to 25 TPS. We'll need autoscale burst policy enabled.
- Model: pinned to redwood/rlhf-xxl-v1 (quantized variant) — latency SLO 150ms median.
- Data residency: US only; SOC2 attestation required for audit (they asked for evidence).

Success criteria for pilot:
1) Stable average latency <= 200ms under typical load (1k queries/mo)
2) No PII leakage incidents and successful completion of security questionnaire
3) Integration of our callbacks for eventing into their CloudWatch pipeline

Open items (ask CS):
- Confirm CS owner and primary technical lead for kickoff.
- Validate dedicated pool sizing (recommend 1x A100 equivalent + burst to 2x for pilot).
- Schedule a 60-min kickoff with customer next week — they prefer mornings PT.

Attachments: 20260809_SOLSTICE_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW), redwood-exec-summary-SolsticeCare.xlsx (deal notes), signed-terms-rdw4821.pdf (T&Cs).

Copying Monica for post-sale billing notes and Tessa for ownership. Ben — I flagged a small credit concession we approved; see exec summary.

Thanks,
Rishi
